cases.question: What time does the clinic open and close on weekdays?
cases.expectedAnswer: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
cases.answer: The clinic opens at 8:00 AM and closes at 7:00 PM on weekdays.

cases.expectedAnswer: Yes, on weekdays between 9:00 AM and 12:00 PM, subject to availability; booked patients are seen first.

cases.question: When does the pharmacy counter close?
cases.expectedAnswer: Same hours as the clinic but it closes 30 minutes earlier each day.
cases.answer: The pharmacy counter closes 30 minutes earlier than the clinic: 6:30 PM Monday‑Friday and 1:30 PM on Saturday.

cases.question: How much do general and specialist consultations cost?
cases.expectedAnswer: General consultation 500 rupees, specialist consultation 900 rupees.
cases.answer: A standard general consultation costs 500 rupees and a specialist consultation costs 900 rupees.

cases.question: How much is a follow-up visit if it is within a week of the first consultation?
cases.expectedAnswer: Follow-up visits within 7 days of the original consultation are charged at half price.
cases.answer: A follow-up visit within 7 days of the original consultation is charged at half price, i.e., 250 rupees for a general consultation or 450 rupees for a specialist consultation.

cases.question: What payment methods do you accept?
cases.expectedAnswer: Cash, debit or credit cards, or UPI.
cases.answer: Cash, debit or credit cards, or UPI.

cases.question: How can a patient get a copy of an old receipt?
cases.expectedAnswer: Request it at the front desk or by email; requests are processed within 2 working days.
cases.answer: A patient can request an itemised bill or a copy of a past receipt at the front desk or by email, and the request will be processed within 2 working days.

cases.question: How late can I cancel an appointment without being charged?
cases.expectedAnswer: Free of charge up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.
cases.answer: You can cancel an appointment up to 24 hours before the scheduled time without incurring a fee.

cases.question: What is the fee for cancelling less than a day before the appointment?
cases.expectedAnswer: A late cancellation fee of 300 rupees, added to the next bill.
cases.answer: 300 rupees

cases.question: What happens if a patient misses three appointments without notice?
cases.expectedAnswer: If it happens within six months, future bookings must be confirmed by phone one day in advance.
cases.answer: Future bookings must be confirmed by phone one day in advance.

cases.question: Which insurance companies is the clinic partnered with?
cases.expectedAnswer: CareShield, MediSecure and HealthFirst.
cases.answer: CareShield, MediSecure and HealthFirst

cases.question: What documents does a patient need to bring to use their insurance?
cases.expectedAnswer: Their insurance card and a government photo ID, at every visit.
cases.answer: Patients must bring their insurance card and a government photo ID to every visit.

cases.question: My insurer is not one of your partners. Can I still claim the cost back?
cases.expectedAnswer: Yes. Pay at the visit; the clinic provides the documents to claim a reimbursement directly from the insurer.
cases.answer: Yes. If your insurer is not a partner, you pay at the visit and the clinic will provide the necessary documents so you can claim reimbursement directly from your insurer.
